home.title: E-DragonBoat
home.lead: Platform for dragon boat teams: record free training from the mobile app, review it in this panel with charts, GPS maps and export, and manage your crew.
home.featTraining: Training: sessions uploaded from the app, filtered by your team; detail with summary, tables, charts (distance, speed, SPM, DPS, strokes) and course map.
home.featMaps: Maps and JPG: course on map (or satellite); you can download an image with the map and a summary (date, team, boat, paddlers, distance in m).
home.featTeam: Team: club data and roles (captain, coach, paddler). The captain can edit the team name and country, delete it and invite by email. The coach sees the same in training and crew, and can change roles and remove members, but cannot invite or edit team data.
home.featAccount: Account: your profile, password and language. The crew is under Team.
home.featCompetitions: Races: runs uploaded from the app when you tap Done; same detail as training (charts, map).

login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Same user as in the mobile app and the API.

register.title: Create account
register.subtitleHtml: Sign up with email and password (no email verification). You can then create your team in Team.
register.footerHtml: Already have an account? Log in
register.errorPasswordShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.

account.title: Account
account.pwdMismatch: The new passwords do not match.
account.noTeamHtml: You have no team. You can create one in Team.

sessionDetail.title: Session {id}
sessionDetail.paddlerNoteHtml: As a paddler you only see the summary and the map.
sessionDetail.deleteConfirm: Delete this training session? This cannot be undone.
sessionDetail.headingSamples: Per-second samples (all keys in each point)
sessionDetail.chartForceHint: Peaks per second (bar only if there was a reading that second).
sessionDetail.mapIntro: Boat track with GPS points from the app (one position per second, when signal is available).
sessionDetail.mapDownloadHint: Download the map with the training summary (JPG).
sessionDetail.mapNoGps: No GPS coordinates in this session (older recording or no signal).
sessionDetail.exploreHint: Lower axis: time (seconds). Upper axis: distance in metres (when distanceMeters is present). You can overlay up to three Y series.

sessions.title: Open training
sessions.filterHint: Only sessions whose teamName in the app matches this team’s name (case-insensitive) are listed.
sessions.noTeamHintHtml: You have no team: all your sessions are shown. Create one from the Team menu to filter by name.
sessions.emptyHintWithTeamHtml: In the app, the session must use the same team name as {teamName}.
sessions.emptyHintNoTeam: Save a session from the app with this account.
sessions.dayMapAria: Combined map for the selected day
sessions.dayMapHint: Download the map with the day summary (JPG).
sessions.mapNoGpsDay: No GPS coordinates in the sessions for that day.
sessions.jpgExportError: Could not generate the JPG (sometimes because map tiles are still loading). Wait for the map to load and try again, or use a screenshot.

errors.notFoundDeploy: Resource not found (404). Upload the updated app/main.py (routes /api/v1/profile and DELETE /api/v1/equipo/{id}) or the full project, then restart: sudo systemctl restart edragonboat-api.
